decisions.reason: As a sensor module with its own product page, it fits the firm's stated platform expansion and the prior visible commitment makes management inclined to continue despite any mixed results.

Although it was less prominently presented, a voltage measurement module is a core building block for the firm's measurement and prototyping ecosystem, so management is likely to retain it unless weakness becomes unmistakable.
A CAN bus interface is closely aligned with German automation and embedded-use cases, and its strong fit with the modular control and communication platform supports continued commitment.

This CO2 sensor module received dedicated visibility and supports the firm's sensing strategy, so sunk development effort and public commitment make withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
